tasks.description: Ingest raw records from the upstream source into a staging area. This stage has no prerequisites and is the first stage in the pipeline. It should handle errors and exceptions properly.
acceptance_criteria: Given raw records from the upstream source, when the ingest stage is executed, then the records are stored in the staging area.

tasks.description: Validate the ingested records against the schema, rejecting malformed rows. This stage depends on the ingest stage and should handle validation errors properly.
acceptance_criteria: Given ingested records, when the validation stage is executed, then malformed rows are rejected and valid rows are passed to the next stage.

tasks.description: Transform the validated records into the canonical internal format. This stage depends on the validation stage and should handle transformation errors properly.
acceptance_criteria: Given validated records, when the transformation stage is executed, then the records are transformed into the canonical internal format.

tasks.description: Deduplicate the transformed records, removing exact and near-duplicate entries. This stage depends on the transformation stage and should handle deduplication errors properly.
acceptance_criteria: Given transformed records, when the deduplication stage is executed, then exact and near-duplicate entries are removed.

tasks.description: Load the deduplicated records into the target warehouse. This stage depends on the deduplication stage and should handle loading errors properly.
acceptance_criteria: Given deduplicated records, when the load stage is executed, then the records are loaded into the target warehouse.

tasks.description: Notify downstream consumers that fresh data is available. This stage depends on the load stage and should handle notification errors properly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful load, when the notification stage is executed, then downstream consumers are notified that fresh data is available.
